name: Night shift
question: What does a Turnleaf do when the light goes?
expectedObservationsText: Twenty Turnleafs and twenty Sunbeads on a sugar patch under the day and night light cycle. A Turnleaf makes food from light when there is enough of it and drinks sugar when the light is low; a Sunbead only uses light. The card counts the Turnleafs' mode changes and the carbon they took in each way.
